text: {"lessons":["Judge each holding by its current outlook and a planned thesis, not by the discomfort of a loss; avoid selling impulsively after declines.","Do not treat a lower price or a recent sale as a reason to buy back; reassess fundamentals, risk, and portfolio fit before adding.","Keep trades and position sizes deliberate, preserving enough cash and avoiding repeated dip-buying without a clear long-term rationale."]}
